name: ui-dock-layout
description: DockLayout — UI factory (1:1 with the @almadar/ui dock-layout pattern).

schema.description: DockLayout — UI factory (1:1 with the @almadar/ui dock-layout pattern).
schema.name: ui-dock-layout

ariaBusy.description: This region is updating; assistive technology waits before announcing it.
ariaBusy.label: Aria-busy

ariaCurrent.description: Marks the current item in a set: the current page, step, location, date or time.
ariaCurrent.label: Aria-current

ariaDescribedby.description: Id of the element whose text describes this one (help text, error).
ariaDescribedby.label: Aria-describedby

ariaExpanded.description: Whether the element it controls is expanded.
ariaExpanded.label: Aria-expanded

ariaHidden.description: Hide from assistive technology (decorative content only).
ariaHidden.label: Aria-hidden

ariaLabel.description: Accessible name read by screen readers when the visible text is missing or not descriptive (e.g. an icon-only control).
ariaLabel.label: Aria-label

ariaLabelledby.description: Id of the element whose text names this one.
ariaLabelledby.label: Aria-labelledby

ariaLive.description: Announce changes to this region: polite waits for a pause, assertive interrupts.
ariaLive.label: Aria-live

ariaSelected.description: Whether this item is selected (tabs, options, grid cells).
ariaSelected.label: Aria-selected

bottomPanelHeight.description: Bottom panel size as a SplitPane ratio (0-100, percentage given to the panel). @default 30
bottomPanelHeight.label: Bottom Panel Height

bottomPanelLabel.description: Compact: the top-bar button that opens `bottomPanel`.
bottomPanelLabel.label: Bottom Panel Label

bottomPanelMinSize.description: Minimum bottom panel size in pixels, forwarded to SplitPane's `minSize`. @default 120
bottomPanelMinSize.label: Bottom Panel Min Size

className.description: Additional CSS classes on the root frame.
className.label: Class Name

compact.description: The mobile variant; decided by the viewport (narrower than 1024px) when omitted.
compact.label: Compact

dir.description: Text direction of this element's content.
dir.label: Dir

enter.description: How this element animates in when it mounts (theme-styled); overrides the theme's default slot entry. `none` opts out.
enter.label: Enter

enterDelay.description: Stagger step for the entry: waits this many `--motion-enter-stagger` steps before animating.
enterDelay.label: Enter Delay

lang.description: Language of this element's content (BCP 47, e.g. ar, sl, en).
lang.label: Lang

rail.description: Fixed-width far-left vertical strip (e.g. an icon nav rail).
rail.label: Rail

railWidth.description: Width of `rail` in pixels; the rail sizes the column itself when omitted.
railWidth.label: Rail Width

role.description: WAI-ARIA role when the element's native semantics don't describe it.
role.label: Role

secondarySidebarLabel.description: Compact: the top-bar button that opens `secondarySidebar` (e.g. 'Inspector', 'Chat').
secondarySidebarLabel.label: Secondary Sidebar Label

secondarySidebarWidth.description: Width of `secondarySidebar` in pixels (fixed — not resizable). @default 280
secondarySidebarWidth.label: Secondary Sidebar Width

sidebarMinSize.description: Minimum sidebar size in pixels, forwarded to SplitPane's `minSize`. @default 160
sidebarMinSize.label: Sidebar Min Size

sidebarWidth.description: Sidebar size as a SplitPane ratio (0-100, percentage of the sidebar/main split). @default 20
sidebarWidth.label: Sidebar Width

statusBar.description: Slim strip pinned to the bottom of the frame, below the bottom panel.
statusBar.label: Status Bar

tabIndex.description: 0 puts the element in the Tab order; -1 makes it focusable only programmatically.
tabIndex.label: Tab Index

topBarActions.description: Compact: the host's own actions at the end of the top bar (e.g. Run).
topBarActions.label: Top Bar Actions
